title: REQ · A scene change from a game action emits transitionTo so the scene fades
summary: App emits transitionTo when state.currentScene changes
description: Context: goto_scene events set state.currentScene but nothing emits transitionTo; BootScene already fades out and starts the scene on that event. Desired: App emits transitionTo with the new id after an action changes currentScene.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action that changes currentScene, when it runs, then transitionTo is emitted with the new scene id
Given an action that keeps currentScene, when it runs, then transitionTo is not emitted
technical_constraints: Use useGameStore state for before/after comparison
